title: Superlist — A little less on your mind
headings: A little less on your mind.
Less keeping track. More moving forward.
Catch the thought. Keep your flow.
A full life. A doable day.
The task is only half the story.
On the same page. Without the follow-up.
All your hats.One place to put them.
Your day moves. Your lists do, too.
A little clarity before you start.
